rounds.text: Before Neptune's discovery, this card belonged simply to Water: flowing, hanging, embracing, just like the Hanged Man himself. Suspended upside down, his calm expression gives away the truth, he isn't suffering, he's meditating, gaining a new {b1} through stillness. Crossed legs echo a yoga pose. Neptune, planet of dreams, depth, and sacrifice, and Water's {b2} flow, capture the soul of this quiet surrender.
